text:
so i built this research bot called Ethan and really loaded it up with everything it needs to be good at research..

i gave it 5 specialist skills:

> deep research briefs
> claim and fact checking
> competitor research
> trend monitoring
> a final quality check

it doesn’t just search something and give you a quick summary but it looks for current information, compares different sources, checks important claims etc

you can connect your own plugins later if you want to give it access to more tools or data..

heres a link for the bot, give it a try

> http://x.ai/bot/F5Mm-0O3fPPZjYGIdsycE
